title: Crunchr
shortDescription: Eleven procedural game sounds in one browser tab. Shape them, hear ten versions, and download clean WAVs. No samples, no account, no uploads.

pricing.note: MIT licensed and free to download. itch can take donations; the file stays free either way.

refundPolicy: Nothing to refund: the download is free.

screenshots.caption: The whole instrument: eleven sounds in four groups, seven controls, and a live picture of the wave.
Shape a footstep, then hear it. Length, pitch, punch, body, roughness and fade all update the same renderer that writes the WAV.
Save one WAV or ten versions. Preview the batch, hear a single version, and save it on its own.
The built-in manual explains the instrument and the keyboard shortcuts without leaving the page.
The one-column phone layout: the full sound bank and instrument, with touch-sized controls.
